metadata.selection_basis: Mainland China's #1 MICHELIN Guide cluster: 156 total restaurants announced at the 2026 Shanghai ceremony (1×3★, 12×2★, 38×1★, 35 Bib Gourmand, 70 MICHELIN Selected) and 154 active listings live in the MICHELIN Guide Shanghai Municipality directory as of Nov 25, 2026 (1×3★, 11×2★, 38×1★, 34 Bib Gourmand, 70 Selected), concentrated along Shanghai Metro Lines 1, 2, 10, 12, and 14.

fx_reference.source_label: People's Bank of China / CFETS Official Central Parity Announcement (Nov 16, 2026)

national_cluster_benchmarks.note: 156 announced in 2026 ceremony (1×3★, 12×2★, 38×1★, 35 Bib, 70 Selected); 154 active live in Nov 2026 directory.
2nd largest Mainland cluster; colder late-Feb temperatures than Shanghai.
First 2027 Mainland China edition released Sept 2026; strong Bib Gourmand value.

shanghai_micro_clusters.name: The Bund, Rockbund & Yu Garden (Huangpu East)
shanghai_micro_clusters.highlights: Highest concentration of waterfront 1★/2★ European & Cantonese fine dining plus century-old Bib Gourmand dumpling landmarks.

shanghai_micro_clusters.name: Xintiandi, Huaihai Rd & Laoximen (Huangpu Central)
key_stations: Site of the First CPC National Congress · Xintiandi
shanghai_micro_clusters.highlights: Shikumen heritage dining hub anchored by 2★ T'ang Court, 2★ Canton 8, and Bib Gourmand French bistro Polux.

shanghai_micro_clusters.name: Suzhou Creek / North Shanxi Rd (Jing'an–Huangpu Border)
shanghai_micro_clusters.highlights: Bvlgari Hotel Shanghai culinary enclave housing both 2★ Bao Li Xuan and 1★ Il Ristorante - Niko Romito one stop from East Nanjing Rd.

shanghai_micro_clusters.name: West Nanjing Rd, Jing'an Temple & Zhenning/Yuyuan Rd (Jing'an–Changning)
shanghai_micro_clusters.highlights: Home to Shanghai's sole 3★ restaurant (Taian Table), 2★ vegetarian icon Fu He Hui, and MICHELIN Selected steakhouses.

shanghai_micro_clusters.name: Former French Concession (Xuhui)
shanghai_micro_clusters.highlights: Tree-lined shikumen villas featuring 1★ Le Comptoir de Pierre Gagnaire (Capella) and Shanghainese 1★ classics.

shanghai_micro_clusters.name: Lujiazui Riverfront (Pudong)
shanghai_micro_clusters.highlights: 1 subway stop across the Huangpu River from East Nanjing Rd; home to 1★ Yong Yi Ting and 36F skyline dining at Jade on 36.

restaurants.name: Taian Table
restaurants.address: Garden Office, Building 1, Alley 161, 465 Zhenning Road, Changning, Shanghai
restaurants.nearest_metro: Jiangsu Road Station (Metro Lines 2 & 11), ~10 min walk
restaurants.cost_basis: Official FAQ: Seasonal 10-course menu CNY 2,588/person or 12-course menu CNY 2,888/person × 2 adults; prices are all-inclusive (no extra service charge).
restaurants.exceptions: Closed Sunday & Monday; closed for lunch; reservations open max 90 days ahead (Feb 15, 2027 opened Nov 17, 2026; Mar 9, 2027 opens Dec 9, 2026); CNY 2,000/person deposit; smart casual (no shorts/flip-flops); no 2-person private tables (counter seating around open kitchen).

restaurants.cost_basis: Official PDF Menu: Il Mare tasting RMB 2,388 pp + 10% service (CNY 5,253.60/2 adults); Carta Bianca RMB 2,888 pp + 10% (CNY 6,353.60/2 adults); White Truffle Menu RMB 4,388 pp + 10% (CNY 9,653.60/2 adults). 3-course à la carte ~CNY 4,567+/2 adults incl. 10%.
restaurants.exceptions: Closed Mondays. Tasting menu ordered per entire table. 2027 public holiday exceptions unverified on official page.

restaurants.name: T'ang Court
restaurants.address: 5F, The Langham, Shanghai, Xintiandi, 99 Madang Road, Huangpu, Shanghai
restaurants.nearest_metro: Site of the First CPC National Congress · South Huangpi Road (Lines 1 & 14) or Xintiandi (Lines 10 & 13), ~4 min walk
